purpose: Displays structured row-and-column data with optional sorting, selection, resizing, and reordering.
useWhen: Users need to scan or compare structured data across columns.
Rows need sorting, selection, activation, resizing, or reordering.

avoidWhen.guidance: Use a list or grouped content instead.

supportedInteractions: Select rows in single or multiple modes.
approvedPatterns: Compose header, columns, body, rows, and cells.
Mark the identifying column as the row header.
Control sort and selection state when application data must update.
Wrap with the resizable container and add column resizers for resizing.
Supply drag-and-drop hooks for row reordering.
limitations: Horizontal overflow is handled by the table frame.
Sticky headers require a scrolling ancestor to become visible.
Selection checkboxes are added for toggle-style multiple selection.
accessibility: Give every table an accessible name.
Mark an identifying column as a row header.
Built-in selection controls are labeled for selecting all or one row.
React Aria provides table, sorting, selection, resizing, and drag semantics.
responsive: The frame scrolls horizontally when columns exceed available width.
Use explicit column widths and minimum widths for resizable layouts.
rtl: Validate column resizing and horizontal overflow in both directions.
